name: Linefish
description: The boat-based hand-line fishery's targets: large and medium sparids (red steenbras, red roman, hottentot and kin), sciaenids (geelbek, silverkob), yellowtail (Seriola lalandii) and other linefish. Functional group pooling the source's five linefish compartments - earlier EwE models of this system pooled them the same way, as 'other large pelagics'. Several were badly overfished in the twentieth century.
